versions.text: Verify that the airframe is designed such that all loads resulting from or following single or multiple system failures are limit loads. Also verify that loads resulting from a single component failure are designed as limit loads regardless of probability of occurrence. DoD/MIL Doc: JSSG-2006: para A3.2.22, A4.2.22.
